digest.component_or_area: Repository documentation and source code commentary
propositions: Repository-wide audit against operator standards requires evidence-based inventory of maintained documentation surfaces, external help, developer comments, and durable records across three content shards before any remediation is authorized.

Documentation must conform to formal voice, complete sentences, prohibited punctuation rules, no filler adjectives, and structural paragraph requirements; foundation work establishes policy ownership, validation tooling, and comment governance before derived corrections.

Foundation items F01 through F07 establish documentation policy, prose validation framework, comment policy expansion, generated artifact ownership registry, and documentation navigation before substantive content remediation in batch F08 through F49.

Approved disposition keeps writing rules as authoring guidance without deterministic mechanical enforcement; rejected F02-F04 prose validators and adopted F05 revised generator-local descriptor protocol instead of centralized artifact registry.
Audit closure occurred after foundation items F01-F07 were delivered and substantive corrections F08-F49 were transferred to epic REB-3501 under separate implementation track.
No project files were modified; audit delivered structured remediation register and dispositions, preserved ticket events append-only, and deferred implementation authorization to operator.
